This $8 Pokémon card sells for ??? in a PSA 10 👀 Guess before you swipe

Guess the PSA 10 price of all 3 cheap Pokémon cards, then swipe for the answers. How close were you? 👇

Answers (no peeking 🙈):
#1 Kingambit 220/198 (Scarlet & Violet Base Set): $8.04 raw → $275 PSA 10 (34×)
#2 Larvesta 099/086 (Black Bolt): $9.09 raw → $290 PSA 10 (32×)
#3 Miltank GG24/GG70 (Crown Zenith: Galarian Gallery): $11.77 raw → $232 PSA 10 (20×)

PSA 10 = median eBay sold price over the last 60 days. Raw = TCGplayer market price. Not every card grades a 10, so check centering first (free centering tool at market.driveyourstyle.net).
